snippet.title: Conjurers | Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Defeat the Conjurers. Take their constellations. Conquer the Zodiac.
Conjurers launches on Steam July 28th.
Wishlist now on Steam ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878390/Conjurers/

Defeat a rival Conjurer and their constellation is yours: creatures, stars and all. Every victory makes your army stranger and stronger, a hybrid force built from across the full Zodiac, until only one enemy remains: the Immortal Aquarius.

🌟 Steal constellations from 8 rival Conjurers; their creatures persist and level up across battles
🗺️ Terrain-driven tactics; high ground, Mana Towers and hazards shape every fight
🐉 60 creatures, infinite hybrids; combine Zodiac types to forge Minotaurs, Dragons and more
🃏 Build a deck from 150 cards and manage Mana across every turn

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
#gaming #indiegames #turnbasedstrategy #deckbuilding
